chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Washing the head with the hibiscus removes the dirt and eliminates the filth.'

key_terms.الْخِطْمِيِّ: the hibiscus (a plant used for washing)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on washing the head with hibiscus for removing dirt and filth?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the prominent chain of Abu Basir to Imam al-Sadiq, attributes a specific medicinal and purifying practice to Imam Ali regarding the use of hibiscus (al-khitmi) for washing the head. It highlights the integration of practical hygiene with ritual purity (taharah) in Shia tradition, emphasizing the removal of both physical impurities (daran) and general filth (al-aqtha') as a means to maintain bodily cleanliness for worship.
